trigger: Commit bffe89d ('fixed branch drift', 2026-07-22) was a `git stash pop` committed with its conflicts UNRESOLVED, writing raw git conflict markers into 21 tracked source files across constitutional tiers. The two sides are a cross-era merge: 'Updated upstream' = the branch's own committed MSCA-PF / July-2026 state (bffe89d^ = 5801c4b); 'Stashed changes' = stale orphaned April-2026 RIA / MAESTRO work (topic HORIZON-CL4-2026-05-DIGITAL-EMERGING-02, 2026-04-21 timestamps, UUID runs ec190493/c084e3dd/cb3ad20d). DOD-1 8.1 fixed 7; this entry covers the remaining 14 (Tier 2A instrument schema, Tier 2B call sources, Tier 3 project instantiation, plans, README). 36 conflict regions total.
method_finding_auto_merge: The ticket prescribed the DOD-1 8.1 textual resolver (strip markers, keep upstream, drop stashed). Verification revealed that pure textual marker-resolution is INSUFFICIENT for 2 of the 14 files: the bad `git stash pop` also AUTO-MERGED non-conflicting insertions from the stashed (RIA) side OUTSIDE any conflict marker. In call_constraints.json a second CC-09/CC-10/CC-11 (three pure-RIA constraint objects, duplicate ids, source_document HORIZON-CL4-...-DIGITAL-EMERGING) sit in a shared region between two conflict blocks; scope_requirements.json has the analogous insertion. A textual keep-ours leaves these orphaned RIA objects in the MSCA-PF file (call_constraints +33 lines, scope_requirements +16 lines vs the true upstream), VIOLATING criterion 3 (no residual orphaned-RIA reference). The faithful realization of 'keep Updated upstream' is therefore to restore each file to its exact git 'Updated upstream' blob = bffe89d^ (5801c4b), which is byte-identical to textual keep-ours for the 12 marker-only files AND additionally removes the auto-merged insertions in the 2 contaminated files. Git only emits conflict markers where the two sides diverge, so restoring the 5801c4b blob reconstructs the pristine pre-corruption MSCA-PF file exactly.
safety_checks_before_apply: No commit AFTER bffe89d touched any of the 14 files (`git log bffe89d..HEAD -- <14>` empty) — restoring to 5801c4b loses no legitimate post-corruption edit.
All 14 current working-tree files were byte-identical to their bffe89d-committed (corrupt) content — the corruption is the ONLY delta since 5801c4b.
All 14 5801c4b blobs verified clean: zero conflict markers; every .json parses; RIA tokens gone except the two legitimately-historical files (see per_file_direction_confirmation).

Marker structure audited across all 14 before touching: balanced start/sep/end counts, exact '=======' separator (no stray), no diff3 base markers (|||||||), well-formed SME nesting, all files LF-only.
Applied by writing raw `git show 5801c4b:<path>` blob bytes directly (unsmudged, LF-preserving) rather than `git checkout` (core.autocrlf=true would smudge LF->CRLF).

contradiction_analysis_12_3: In every conflict region the two sides are the coherent MSCA-PF payload (upstream, on the 5801c4b lineage that is the branch's committed pre-stash-pop state and the current selected_call HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01 identity) versus orphaned April-2026 RIA/MAESTRO state (stashed, topic HORIZON-CL4-...-DIGITAL-EMERGING-02). The contradiction is resolved uniformly toward upstream because it is the branch's own committed state and matches the active instrument (MSCA-PF); the stashed side is a dead April branch with no live run lineage. For the 2 auto-merge-contaminated files the contradiction additionally manifested as duplicate-id RIA objects co-existing (unmarked) with the MSCA objects — resolved by restoring the pristine upstream blob, which never contained them.
